thread:
maria: Quick check — putting the Gallium v1 weights in prod-ready path today. s3://redwood/models/gallium-v1/weights-2026-02-10. Before we mark onboarding done I want a short sanity pass for max-context, KV cache format, and any tokenizer oddities. TL;DR checklist: (1) weights reachable, (2) tokenizer length vs tokeniser config, (3) kv cache format compatibility, (4) memory smoke run. Pinged ppl below.

sam: I pulled the weights path and did a tiny run. weights hash looks fine (sha256: a3f4...b9). Noticed tokenizer gives +1 token for lines starting with a space — probably need `add_prefix_space: true` in our tokenizer config for this model.

alex: did a 2-request smoke with max-seq=8192 on a single A100-40. Command: `./inference_smoke --model s3://redwood/models/gallium-v1/weights-2026-02-10 --max-seq 8192 --batch 1 --kv-format auto`

alex: result: first request completed, second hit OOM during decode: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.50 GiB` — stack shows KV cache allocation spike when seq_len jumps during generation.

jia: re: tokenizer — that `add_prefix_space` change is consistent with other BPEs we onboarded. Also confirm tokenizer.json indicates `use_fast: true`? fast tokenizer has slightly different whitespace handling. If the model was trained with huggingface fast/tokenizers, we should mirror that.

sam: kv format note: model metadata lists `kv_format: v2-compact` but our serving runtime defaulted to `v1`. That's probably the root cause of the spike — fallback path attempted in-memory conversion. We should either: (A) serve with `--kv-format v2-compact` or (B) run the migration tool `tools/kv_migrate --in weights --out weights_v1_compat`.

alex: quick mem numbers from the run: base params ~12.3G resident, activations ~6.8G steady, KV cache peak ~18.1G when generating to 6k+ tokens. With v1 conversion path it ballooned ~+4G.

maria: thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) @sam can you try a fresh smoke with explicit `--kv-format v2-compact` and `--tokenizer-config '{"add_prefix_space": true}'`? 2) @jia can you queue a small config PR to set these as model defaults in the model registry? (PR/branch pref: `model-registry/gallium-v1-tokenizer-and-kv`).

sam: on it. Will run smoke with `--kv-format v2-compact --kv-maxlen 1024 --quant 4bit` too to see lower-mem path.

sam: smoke results: completed 3/3 requests at max-seq 8192 using kv-format v2-compact. Peak resident ~35G on A100-40 with 4-bit quantization, no OOM. One oddity: with `kv-maxlen=1024` generation beyond 1024 tokens hits a controlled fallback (latency spike) — expected.

jia: I started the PR draft, adding tokenizer snippet and `preferred_kv_format: "v2-compact"` in the model metadata. Also added a short note: "recommended kv_maxlen default 1024 for single-GPU hosting; increase for Dedicated pools". Link: https://git.redwood/model-registry/pulls/4823 (WIP).

maria: awesome. For the registry entry please also add a pointer to the migration tool and a small smoke-test script under `tests/smoke/gallium-v1.sh` that runs the `--kv-format` and `--tokenizer-config` permutations. Saves future triage.

alex: +1 on test. I pushed a simple `smoke.sh` (invokes run with kv v1/v2 and diff token counts). I included the OOM log snippet in the script output for baseline.

deploy-bot: deploy-checks: model path exists, weights hash verified, metadata schema pass (warnings: tokenizer `use_fast` not set explicitly).

maria: thanks team. Conclusion: don't flip to v1 conversion, set model defaults to v2-compact + add_prefix_space true, add a smoke script, and set kv_maxlen default 1024 for hosted. We'll mark the onboarding checklist item "memory & kv sanity" as blocked -> resolving after PR merges. I'll follow up once PR is merged. :white_check_mark:

sam: FYI i'll attach the exact command I used here for posterity:
```
./inference_smoke \
  --model s3://redwood/models/gallium-v1/weights-2026-02-10 \
  --max-seq 8192 \
  --batch 1 \
  --kv-format v2-compact \
  --kv-maxlen 1024 \
  --tokenizer-config '{"add_prefix_space": true, "use_fast": true}' \
  --quant 4bit
```

maria: perfect — thanks. I'll add a note to the onboarding ticket with the smoke log and close after PR merge. If anyone sees regression on Dedicated tests, re-open thread.
